title: Conveyor Grid Routing
brief: A sorting facility is laid out as a grid of conveyor cells, and each cell has an energy cost to pass a parcel through it. Conveyors only run right or down, so a parcel entering at the top-left cell can only move one cell right or one cell down at each step until it exits through the bottom-right cell.
Implement cheapestRouteCost(grid), where grid is the table of cell costs as rows, and return the lowest total cost of any route a parcel can take across the grid, entry to exit.
